detailed_description:
The target video uses late-1880s Victorian industrial dark fantasy, live-action cinematic look, cold grey daylight leaking from above, wet stone, cast-iron gate, acidic purple-black toxin, coal-dust steam, high contrast.
[Shot 1] A medium-wide lateral tracking shot opens inside <Subject 3>. <Subject 1> from <Picture 2> stands stiff-shouldered on the dry-stone ledge while <Subject 2> from <Picture 3> presses him toward the pool edge with two spears advancing together. The camera trucks left with medium amplitude at moderate speed, matching the side-shift path from <Video 1>. <Subject 1> stares at the spear tips, then shifts weight onto his rear foot until his heels reach the wet stone rim. Iron boots scrape, masked breathing, and spear shafts grind on stone.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to a near-medium push-in. <Subject 1> is forced back half a step; his right foot cracks wet stone. He blocks a spear with his left arm, jaw tight, as shards slide toward the pool and he loses his last stable foothold. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed. <Subject 2> stays on the safe gate side of the ledge.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to a high near angle looking down. A spear strike hits only <Subject 1>'s shoulder side; he leaves the dry-stone ledge and falls into the central toxic pool, body shifting from resistance to freefall with fingers clawing empty air. On impact, purple toxic mist erupts from the liquid surface and instantly engulfs him. The camera pedestals down with medium amplitude at moderate speed. A muffled impact and acid splash ring out while <Subject 2> stops at the gate line.

overall_soundscape:
Iron boots and spear shafts scrape wet stone over low prison ambience and masked breathing. Wet stone cracks underfoot, followed by a muffled body impact, acid splash, and hissing purple vapor.
